entries.text: "I'm a ZAFT Red too, you know!"
"What the Vega Star Union\ndid, I will not forgive!"
"I am no princess now! Come at me!"
"I won't just sit here and take it!"
"He got me where I can't strike!?"
"Even if this is where I die,\nI'll fight to the very end!"
"I never miss a target...\nThat's the freelancer way!"
"Let me show you our way, plenty of it!"
"Can you keep up with my speed!?"
"So no one else becomes\nlike me, I will stop you!"
"Renton, Mama will save\nyou... From that monster!"
"Giving all for a man...\nYou'd get it, Talho!"
"A woman's scorn is scary, you know!"
"I'm not obliged to go this far"
"Struggling is useless...!\nPrepare for the next attack!"
"Well, I gotta show off a bit."
"Pointless. I have a barrier, you know."
"No need to be on guard then"
"You caught me... Not bad at all"
"At this rate, Charles\nwill laugh at us, Holland!"
"Hitting a woman... That's not like you"
"Don't panic in a pinch.\nStay calm and act..."
"So you insist on getting\nin my way, Holland!"
"Target lock! I'll take them all down!"
"I have no time to deal with you!"
"You let your guard down. Wide open...!"
"This is what you get for\nclosing in carelessly!"
"Staying within my range\nwas careless of you!"
"Shinn, don't get so\nhot. Fall back now!"
"Captain, fall back.\nI'll take it from here"
"You still have things you must do!"
"My role is to hold them off!"
"With their range above ours,\nwe need to do something...!"
"This machine was from Gil to me"
"It may be a Second Stage Series unit,\nbut the pilot's skill is lacking."
"Athrun! Your attack\npatterns are in my memory!"
"Careless... You just\ntold me where you are."
"Do you think that's\nenough to stop the Legend!"
"I'll put this data to good use!"
"Damn...! I can't keep\ntaking damage like this!"
"If I'm a legend, I can hold!"
"The Second Stage series...\nas expected, it's good!"
"Traitor who threw away\nFAITH, how dare you!!!"
"I can't afford to lose to you!"
"He read my signal...?\nNo, this is more..."
"For a man doomed to die,\nyou've done well...!"
"Guh...! This one isn't\nlike it was before!"
"Too much damage! Only\none or two more...!"
"I can't toss my life away here...!"
"So that beings like us\nnever come to be again!"
"I promised Gil and the captain\nto live with all my might...!"
"I'll shake it off! The dark\nin the world, and in myself!"
"You know too many secrets!\nYou won't get away!"
"You trampled the Chairman's\nwish! That I can never forgive!"
"This time you must disappear!\nAlong with all of us!!"
"So you alone survived without a care!"
"Archangel! If you stand in my way!"
"If you oppose ZAFT,\nI will show no mercy!"
"Lacus Clyne! Gil's world\nhas no need for you!"
"You only stir up crowds.\nYou won't block Gil!"
"Don't forget it was you\nwho broke the ceasefire!"
"Earth and PLANT... Too\nfar apart, it seems...!"
"Don't forget! Humanity survived\nBlack History thanks to Gil!"
"The Destiny Plan will\noutlast even Black History!"
"Misread it all, and made me your foe!"
"So you stand against Gil after all...!"
"Your twisted dream world,\nI will never accept!"
"I am Lowen General! The\nyoung lion of Chimera!"
"I'm not the man I was in your ranks!"
"A lion goes all out for rabbits!"
"Women other than Edel\nhave no right to live!"
"Women... All of you,\nvanish from this world!"
"I know your skills well! But\nI have my master behind me!"
"Don't get the wrong idea just\nbecause I went easy on you!"
"If you'd just cry softly,\nyou'd be cuter than this!"
"You hothead...! Just\nlooking at you irks me!"
"The Heat! Feel the true lion's power!"
"I will shred both machine and pilot!"
"I'll carve you up, soul and all!"
"Well done, Shuran! Truly my soul mate!"
"What? What did you want to do?"
"Heh heh heh... This\ngrace is for Admiral Edel"
"I serve Admiral Edel...\nI can't afford a wound"
"Bunglers! Fools! Dunces!\nGo home and try again!"
"Only one woman alive\nmay touch my body!"
"You dare damage the\nChaos Leo he gave me!"
"Don't get it wrong. I\ntook that on purpose!"
"Damn it! I know his tricks, so why!"
"For his sake, this pain is nothing!"
"This wound proves loyalty\nto Edel! My medal!"
"Just as I thought, women as a breed\nmust not exiiist!"
"This blood and pain go\nto Edel! That's my war!"
"You think you can kill me?\nMy life belongs to him!"
"S-Such a blunder! I\ncan't show this to Edel!"
"Rather than betray her\nhopes, I'd die to atone!"
"Ugh! This stress, I'll\npay it back double!"
"I will carry out my assigned\nmission without fail!"
"I won't go easy on women either!"
"I cannot approve of a woman\nstanding on a battlefield...!"
"This beautiful Earth,\nI won't hand it over to you!"
"I despise women like you the most...!"
"Wherever you flee, My claws tear you!"
"I'll throw everything I've got into this!"
"This is the power that\nprotects the world!!"
"A duel is Chaos Leo's true strength!"
"Damn...! To make such a basic mistake!"
"Too wide a swing, so that happens!"
"If I dodge their attacks,\nit'll shake their nerve...!"
"Don't go on the defensive! Keep an\nattacking mindset even when dodging!"
"I can't let a woman touch me...!"
"No need to dodge! Advance, Chaos Leo!"
"I cannot approve of such\nbehavior in a lady...!"
"Fighting me is futile!\nLadies, please step back!"
"Pain I endure with spirit! Let's go!"
"No effect...! Can such blows hurt me?"
"Good attack! Let me learn from it!"
"I, Lowen General, will\nfight to the very end!"
"My feelings for Brigadier General Edel\nsustain me now!"
"I will not die! While\nshe lives in my heart!"
"I won't give up until my last breath!\nThat's Chimera spirit!"
"Surviving is our duty...!\nWe will fulfill it!"
"I need to deal damage\nwhenever I can...!"
"Damn! To let an enemy\nget away like this!"
"What's wrong, Lieutenant\nEmma! I need no sympathy!"
"Kamille! Trying to stop me is useless!"
"So the enemy was one step ahead...!"
"Kamille! We won't let you stop us!"
"Kamille! Right now I am, as\na woman, truly fulfilled!"
"A man who thinks only of himself!"
"Captain, you always do that...\nalways put yourself above us!"
"The unit Scirocco gave\nme... I'll master it!"
"It's alright! I believe\nRenton can do it!"
"Let's do what we believe in, Eureka!"
"Yeah! With Renton by my side,\nI feel like I can do anything!"
"I feel I can do something now!"
"I won't give up hope! For the future!"
"I believe it! This\nfight is to end the war!"
"I'll do it! For\neveryone... and for Eureka!"
"Let's go, Nirvash!\nEureka is waiting for us!"
"I'll do it... I'll show\nyou! Together with Eureka!"
"The Renton of now can do it!"
"Amazing! It moves just as I think!"
"I've got Eureka and Nirvash with me!"
"You're really going\nto fight?! All of you!"
"Don't think you can steal our freedom!"
"We won't let you do as you please!"
"Nirvash... you move the way I want!"
"Stop this! I don't want to fight!"
"Sorry, Nirvash! I'll fix you up later!"
"Let's do this right! Together, as one!"
"I won't give up! No matter what!"
"Eureka! I'll protect both you\nand Nirvash, no matter what!"
"This isn't the time\nfor this kind of thing!"
"Ugh! Can't let you get me again...!"
"We can catch up now! Let's go, Eureka!"
"Stay out of my way! I\nhave to go to Eureka!"
"Eureka... Eureka is\nwaiting! I won't fall here!"
"Can't just wait! We go take it!"
"I'll follow my own path...\nJust as Charles taught me!"
"This war must stop! I have to stop it!"
"To protect Eureka, I'd\neven fight you, Ray!"
"Dewey Novak! Your way will\nnever save this world!"
"No, I'll fight too...! With\nRenton, I'm not scared!"
"We want to live in this world too...!"
"For all who live in this world!"
"I won't hand this world over to you!"
"Eureka isn't a tool for your wishes!"
"Get out of my way! I'm\ngoing to bring Eureka back!!"
"The Edel! We will protect this world!"
"Why... why did it\nhave to come to this!!"
"I can do it when I try!"
"What are you doing?! That was close!"
"Hey, hey! No way! This is no joke!"
"Sis, this is bad!\nThis is reeeally bad!!"
"I'm not a kid forever! Bring it on!"
"I'll do it... I'll show\nit! Even I can do this!!"
"Please, Nirvash! Give\nme power to save Eureka!"
"I can do it when I must!"
"Maybe Renton and Nirvash\nare made for each other!"
"Turns out I can handle it well!"
"Puny hits like that,\nno matter how many!"
"Be patient...! Now is the\ntime to hold back, Renton...!!"
"This won't cut it! Not like this!"
"Don't chicken out, me...!\nIf I run, that's lame...!"
"Don't beg! Win it! Then it's granted!"
"Hold on! The fight's not over yet!"
"Jamil! I'll take both work and love!"
"No choice. I'll be the shield, Witz"
"Things like this\njust kind of get me down..."
"So no one-shot kill, thanks for that!"
"Teaming up on me...\nI really hate that!"
"Just taking a hit isn't my style!"
"Man, what a pain to deal with!"
"Things won't go the way\nyou planned, not this time!"
"Running out of room to show off...?"
"Gah... I'll just have\nto call this a handicap!"
"Huh... you know how to have fun!"
"If it weren't this tough,\nit wouldn't be any fun!"
"You two brothers, haven't\nyou had enough yet!?"
"I can't afford to be\ntaken down here..."
"You'd need more skill\nthan that to hit me!"
"You've no clue what you're in for!"
"Now then, shall we get\nthis party started?!"
"Out of ammo... and\nout of breath, huh..."
"Defeat you and the colony won't fall!"
"Thought you could hit my blind spot!"
"Ugh! So you've got some real power...!"
"I won't accept it...! Not this result!"
"A deal's a deal! That's my way!"
"There's no need for\nnegotiation on this job!"
"I'll have to get a little rough!"
"I don't have that much time to\nspare, either! I'll keep this brief!"
"I'd rather not, but I have no choice!"
"Roger, let's beat him to a pulp."
"It seems you want an\nencore. I shall oblige!"
"It's a special party!\nLet's go all out!"
"A present from me! Take\nit without reserve!"
"Let me show you Big O's finest!"
"Can you read the last word I write!?"
"Schwarzwald! This is the\ntruth of this battle!!"
"Beck! This is what a true pro is!!"
"Time is limited... I'll\ntake you all at once!"
"Big O, got it! I'll\nfollow your move here!"
"I will continue to fight\nwith Big O! With this power!!"
"To make memories for the future,\nI pull this trigger!!"
"In the name of Roger\nSmith, I sentence you!!"
"Show your hand to be fair, I say!"
"I'd rather not resort to\nsuch crude revenge...!"
"Big O, there's no need to let\nhim have his way like this!"
"In any age, there are those\nwho solve things with violence!"
"Quite a flashy welcome you gave me!"
"Depends on the foe. Not needed here!"
"For a negotiator, force is\nthe last resort, Dorothy."
"Wait! I have something\nto give you as well!"
"Part of the job! I'll get it done!"
"No choice. Wait for the next chance"
"Stop that! Time is for using well!"
"Big O is by no means sluggish!"
"I'd hate to scuff it for Norman."
"Seems you still don't understand\nBig O's power, Beck!"
"This isn't even worth a minor news item,\nSchwarzwald!"
"Schwarzwald! No, Michael Seebach!\nStop your futile resistance!"
"Same look, but inside? Not at all!"
"Even after this, you still\nintend to play god!? Alex!"
"Even the third Big is\nno match for Big O!"
"Big O knew that attack was coming..."
"I know how to defend myself too"
"I don't intend to use it as a shield."
"Big O's arm is not a shield."
"This is no time for talk like that."
"Don't think attacks\nlike that can stop me!"
"Big O does not fall so easily!"
"There are always those\nwho love a big fuss."
"It seems you are not\none to be reasoned with!"
"Enough is enough! You've gone too far!"
"Do you not know any manners, you?"
"Hard to stay cool in a spot like this."
"That was something I\nknew from the start."
"Keep this up and you, will regret it."
"Not good, Dorothy. A lady\nshouldn't talk like that"
"T-this is the power\nof that red Big...!"
"Tch! It seems your menace\nis more than just skin deep!"
"I... and Big O will not\nbecome the power you seek!"
"Ngh...! To fall into such a situation!"
"What's going on...?\nCan you move, Big O!?"
"I won't whine, but\nthis is a real bind...!"
"This is bad... One of\nmy worst crises...!"
"Hmph... this is unfortunate,\nbut watch my brilliant comeback!"
"This can't be! Me, in such a state!"
"Now, Dorothy. How shall\nwe stage our comeback?"
"Not here...! I have things to do!"
"That's nothing new, is it? Time to run"
"Not my style, but\nI'll do this by force!"
"Hit by this fist, you won't walk away!"
"Meant for balance, but\nit works for this too!"
"A poor mummy roused by grave\nrobbers...! Go back to your slumber!"
"I'll tear off those\nbandages by beating you!"
"Schwarzwald! I will show you an\nending your prophecy lacks!"
"Whoever you are, you're\nno match for Big O!"
"No matter how you\nrevive, your path is one!"
"A man who does nothing but dream!\nStay in your dreams forever!!"
"You, too, are just a pitiful monster\ncursed by memories of the past!"
"Paid well, but I should\nhave picked my client!"
"I won't let them steal my freedom!"
"I'd rather never raise\na hand to a woman..."
"You don't know how to\nwoo a lady, Scirocco!"
"Ghingnham! Sorry, but I've no\nintention of indulging your aesthetics!"
"Trying to force another person's\ndestiny to your will...!"
"I am not bound by your rules!"
"You can protect a diamond, but\nnot the rules of the world!?"
"Then let us begin the ogre hunt!"
"Old grudges don't matter!\nYou're my foe and Big O's!"
"Dorothy is right. So I will judge you!"
"The Edel! The world is not your toy!!"
"The Edel! The stage you\nset is at its climax!"
"Neither I nor the world\nhas time for your whims!"
"I won't watch you create a world"
"Asakim! In God's name I\njudge you! You are guilty!"
"To establish my own existence,\nAsakim! I will defeat you!"
"I'd rather talk it\nout, but no choice...!"
"Surprised? Big O has\nequipment like this too."
"This is A Baoa Qu all over again!"
"Not yet! I won't back down now!"
"Damn!\nIs this as far as the Dias can go?!"
"I won't let the Titans run wild!"
"Even that giant must\nhave a weak point...!"
"I'm not keen, but no choice now..."
"Heh heh, did you think\nthat attack ended it!"
"I'll stake my career:\nthe Anomaly is mine!"
"Emaan, are you set on blocking me?!"
"Tch! On par with our devices, huh!"
"I'm lacking in power,\nbut how about speed!"
"You tried to nip it in the bud!"
"Too bad! You'll never see me again!"
"We're getting out! We can't die here!"
"If I don't beat you,\nsomeone gets hurt!"
"Why... why must we fight like this!"
"If you try to claim\nEarth, I will fight!"
"A black Gundam...! Could\nit be called Black Doll!?"
"Don't think you can control us too!"
"By expanding the war,\nwhat are you doing?!"
"Don't cling to the\npast! Look ahead, Shinn!"
"Edel Bernal! You won't\nhave the world your way!"
"Rule by one alone isn't\nneeded on this Earth!"
"To build a world where people can\nsleep in peace... I'll defeat you!"
"If you take lives for selfish\nreasons, I won't forgive you!"
"It's a hammer! Hit by\nthis and you're done for!"
"I won't let this world\nbecome Black History!"
"I'll stop Turn X's Moonlight\nButterfly with the Turn A!"
"Lady Sochie! Leave the rest to me!"
"Lady Dianna, leave the rest to me!"
"This much I can block with armor...!"
"I won't let you have your way!"
"No way! To be done in like this!"
"My beam rifle isn't just for show!"
"I Field activate! Auto-reaction\nto warnings! Set! Search!"
"Everyone, step back! Activating\nthe Moonlight Butterfly System!"
"Close in, then strike in one go!"
"Why can't you just talk\nit out?! You two...!!"
"If my opponent is Harry,\nI can't let my guard down!"
"Even against a Wodom,\nI've got to do it!"
"As long as I avoid\nthat long-range Beam!"
"I don't want to attack\nLady Dianna's Soleil, but!"
"Gym Ghingnham! I fight\nthis battle because of you!"
"Turn A is Turn X's\nbig brother, isn't it?!"
"Ghingnham! I won't let you\nrecreate the Black History!"
"If you mean to repeat Black History,\nyou're Lady Dianna's enemy!"
"Is that machine a White Doll too?!"
"I'm not about to just\nstand here and take it!"
"I'll be your shield! Fall back now!"
"Hold on, White Doll! You're\ncalled Gundam, right?!"
"If Turn Types fight,\nhumanity could be destroyed!"
"What? The White Doll's counter-force is\nweak!? Is automatic control not enough!?"
"The White Doll... hates\nthe Gundam that much!?"
"Are you really going to fight me!?"
"Gah! Are they really\nresonating with Turn X!?"
"Dead-aim or not, White\nDoll can take it!"
"Ghingnham! I can't afford\nto be hit by your attack!"
"Turn A and Turn X are\nnullifying each other's power!?"
"A Beam Saber can block the attack!"
"Lady Sochie! Miashei!\nI'll take care of this!"
"Facing the guards' SUMO of all things!"
"If you hurt the Kapool,\nLady Sochie will be mad..."
"With this machine... I can do it!"
"N-No good, it's moving on its own...!"
"Stop it! I have no\nintention of fighting!!"
"Now, as good as they say, or...!"
"Down the Gundam and I'm an ace!"
"I'll beat you and become an ace!"
"Hmph, no need to stay on guard."
"Was that all you had to fight me?"
"Ha! Seems like I wasn't\nneeded after all."
"No time for a rich man's games!"
"As I thought, he's not\njust a mobile suit!"
"Not just riding a\nflashy suit for show...!"
"Calm down! Calm down!\nThat's the first thing!"
"This is some mistake! It must be!"
"So it's all money?! Money talks, huh?!"
"At this rate, we'll be torn apart!"
"How do I fight a guy like that!?"
"I, I don't want you hitting there!"
"W, what have you done to me!?"
"Think! I must come up with something!"
"To push me this far...\nHe's a true ace, isn't he!?"
"Don't get cocky for being a Gundam!"
"It's the machine specs! Not my skill!"
"Even against a Gundam,\nthere's always a way!"
"At this rate, we'll be picked off!"
"I endured it! Watch\nme turn this around!"
"Keep your jokes to your mech's color!"
"Gold mechs are strong...\nIs that the rule?!"
"If that color held a\nhammer, it'd look like...!"
"Bow down before us, the\nVegan Empire's forces!"
"Getter! You're the one I can't forgive!"
"Whoa! Not so easy to take me down!"
"You! Do you know who I am!?"
"Not yet! I can win with guts!"
"W-what do I do!? What should I do!?"
"Blast! Not until I land a blow in return!"
"Ugh! He truly is a brave one...!"
"To take this much punishment\nfrom a mere woman!"
"I won't be beaten to a pulp!"
"What is this!? What did they do!?"
"T-that I... could be driven this far!"
"I won't lose! I refuse to lose!"
"I was a fool to oppose Mazinger!"
"M-Mazinger Z! Not until I beat you!"
"A hero is Mazinger...\nI have to admit it!"
"Grendizer... If I must,\nI'll die with you!"
"T, this is the power of Mazinger!?"
"Feel the power of our Tenchi wings!"
"In this holy city, no free rein!"
"A lively one, eh...\nI'll take you first!"
"You need not dirty\nyour hands, Lord Toma."
"I'm reluctant... but this, too,\nis for Lord Toma's sake...!"
"Tch... to think it\nwould come to this..."
"This is the power of the Solar Wing\nthat Lord Toma loved...?"
"A mere cultivated creature\ncannot hope to face me."
"My power is but a spark...\nYou can't even break that."
"You don't see the\nsin you commit now..."
"For the Solar Wing to be so weak...\nLord Toma will be saddened..."
"Tch! You are prey we\nhunt, yet you dare...!!"
"Damn you... I won't let this slide!"
"If I retreat here,\nI could never face Lord Toma...!"
"No...! Until Toma-sama's grief\nis healed, I will not fall!"
"Is this too some curse\nleft by Apollonius...!?"
"Ugh!? What evil power...!\nThis one must be hunted!"
"Ngh! That a defiled Wingless\ncould wield such power...!!"
"I can't lose! I must\nstop paradise's fall!!"
"Gah! The Solar Wing regains its power!?"
"Butterfly of ruin... I won't let you!"
"Giant! Will you null all and\ncreate a new world again!"
"I can't do a thing against them...!!"
"Dodged a fatal blow, but next time...!"
"The unit still moves...!\nI can still fight!!"
"I will not retreat from this place!"
"Sorry, this is the end of the line!"
"This old Hyakki warrior won't die!\nI refuse to die!!"
"Gotta give it all...\nBut not in the mood!"
"You showed up, so let's do this!"
"It's not like I do this for fun!"
"Stop or I'll fire! I'll fire anyway!"
"Hmph, flying with a girl is weird..."
"Wrapped in night fog,\nlet's make our getaway!"
"No way! For me, Glomar\nis a nest of love!"
"Lieea, can't you do well without me?"
"Let's have some fun! Blast one out!"
"OK, with me, no doubt about it!"
"Damn, no good! I gave too much early!"
"Running away is winning, as they say."
"How do you like that!\nChange your mind yet?"
"This is my technique.\nDon't get too dazzled!"
"Too pushy and girls will hate you."
"Only girls should be fighting over me!"
"What I want isn't a slap,\nbut a kiss, you know"
"Whew, taking that head-on was no joke."
"What a woman! I'm spent just running!"
"I can't afford to lose in the air!"
"Couldn't dodge it all!\nMan, that was lame."
"Moves like I do?\nGetting hit by that...!"
"You two aren't cut out for battle!"
"Huh... keeping up with\nOrguss in the air!"
"Rather than a hit, I'd take a kiss."
"Don't tell me... you\ndon't want to fight me?"
"Big guy, brains... and you're good too"
"Thought you were a fool,\nI underestimated you"
"Ugh! We need to fix this fast..."
"No way, I might really get taken out!"
"Ugh, hate it. Men, what a pain..."
"Being beaten by a woman doesn't feel so\nbad... No, on second thought, it does...!"
"Later, I'll teach you\nhow to be a father!"
"This is crazy! Let it be a dream!"
"Gah! One more hit and I'll fall apart!"
"Ah, screw it! With my\ntail on fire, I'm strong!"
"Guh! But I've always been\nstrong at the last stand!"
"Ugh! Can't fully control\nthe inertia after all!"
"Now I'm really pissed!\nIf it's a man, no mercy!"
"Whoa! Stay clear of a woman's rage!"
"Play nice and get cocky... You brat!"
"What the...! I'm almost\nkilled by my own daughter!"
"Chiram...! So it's not\ncapture, You intend to kill me!"
"You clumsy Emaan! At\nthis rate, I'll die!"
"Damn! After all this, this is it?!"
"Surfers flirt as rule!\nI can't fall behind!"
"I hate guys like that...!\nSneaking around in the shadows!"
"If I win, your cute girlfriend\nwill be crying, won't she..."
"Damn! Why do I have to\nfight my own daughter?"
"Never thought I'd fight you for real!"
"Small cravings charm me... But\nEdel! Your ambition is ugly!"
"Even a beauty... Some\nlines I won't cross!"
"You stiff samurai! Loosen\nup your head a bit!"
"The ladies' man takes\non the tough guy!"
"The Edel! Even I can't\nkeep up with your tastes!"
"I'll guard the world\nmy way! Not yours!"
"Girls are great, huh!\nWant me to teach you?"
"In this world, you can't\nflinch at just any alien!"
"Sadly, I know your\ntactics all too well!"
"Know this? I'm an\nace even in battle..."
"Call me a Sky Wing, then\nI'd rather be love's Cupid!"
"If we're talking demons,\nTina's old man's worse!"
"Old habit. Can't help\nbut try to charm a lady"
"Damn it! A Mazinger won't\ngo down that easily!"
"You think that attack\nwill work on me?!"
"Z alloy won't budge an inch on this!"
"Damn it! At this rate, I'm done!!"
"Ow... Banged my head on the canopy"
"Come at me, all of you!\nI'll knock you all back!"
"Gah! But I'm not giving up this fight!"
"Damn! Then I'll show you\nMazinger's true power!"
"Me... Koji Kabuto...\nDying that easy? No way!"
"Damn! Still okay, but next is rough..."
"Tch! A worthy opponent,\nI gotta keep my guard up"
"Heh, not bad, matching\nMazinger toe to toe!"
"Don't make me laugh! Me\nand Mazinger won't die!"
"What's wrong? Is that all you've got!?"
"Damn! I can't believe\nI took a direct hit!"
"Your attacks don't mean\na thing to my Mazinger!"
